project_scope: Second phase of the TH 494 corridor reconstruction. The project includes reconstruction of mainline pavement, drainage, signals, ADA improvements, and work on multiple bridges. Listed bridge structures include 27430, 27425, 27429, 27W58, 27W59, 9078, 27V63, 27V38, 27052B, 27052D, 27424, 27V33, 27V35, and 27408; bridge 9078 is explicitly noted for rehabilitation, while the others are included under the broader bridges scope. services: Design-build services with construction field monitoring and oversight; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:

- No specific span data, special bridge types, or innovative structural features are provided.
- Potential relevance remains due to bridge rehabilitation and possible planning component within design-build delivery.
